dream: The flat rock slid down a fence that leaned wrong, carried by the heavy lid I could not hold. I pressed the tired wedge against the fevered card, feeling the air thick as wet paper between my thumb and the edge. The slip refused to move, just a ghost I had drawn on the warm heat. I woke with the flat stone still biting the air, wondering if I was the one slipping or if the whole world was just a drawing on a fevered chip.
